ev_department_map_v1: Northstar Technologies operating model defines 25 inter-department channels across Finance, Engineering, AI and Data, Operations, Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Compliance, each with a label and kind, feeding the company KPI node.
ev_strategy_memo_1: Strategic directive for fiscal operations: Northstar Technologies prioritizes protecting enterprise customer retention first, maintaining service reliability across core customer journeys before pursuing initiatives to expand gross margin.
ev_billing_runbook_gap: Warning: Automated exception handling for wf_billing_recon is not documented in this runbook. If a reconciliation batch fails, manual intervention by role_billing_ops_lead or role_billing_specialist is required to isolate anomalies and complete the run.
ev_knowledge_matrix_billing: Knowledge assessment for wf_billing_recon: Operational expertise for resolving complex billing reconciliation exceptions (kn_billing_exception) is concentrated solely in role_billing_ops_lead and role_billing_specialist, with no cross-trained backup roles.
ev_invoicing_sop: Standard Operating Procedure: The invoice generation workflow (wf_invoicing) on sys_invoicing may execute only after billing reconciliation (wf_billing_recon) completes successfully and posts the verified ledger entries.
ev_incident_22: Post-incident review INC-22: A failure in vendor reconciliation (wf_vendor_reconciliation) resulted in uncaptured data discrepancies, requiring manual audit remediation and partner settlements that cost about $40M to correct.
ev_incident_31: Post-incident review INC-31: Unresolved billing reconciliation failures in wf_billing_recon propagated incorrect ledger entries to customer accounts, costing about $60M in credits and rework across enterprise accounts.
ev_incident_review_q2: Incident Management Quarterly Review: The site reliability engineering team (role_sre) operating wf_incident_mgmt resolved all Sev-1 and P1 production incidents within contractual SLA targets throughout Q2.
ev_soc2_register_intro: Control CC7.2 (ctl_soc2_audit_logging): The system must capture continuous audit-log event streams (ds_audit_log) from sys_audit_service, and evidence records must be securely retained for 12 months for compliance audit verification.
ev_finance_forecast_q3: Q3 Financial Forecast: Operational expense projections indicate FluxBehavior usage costs rise about 1.5% a month due to query volume growth, while Operations contractor costs (dept_operations) rise about 1% a month.
ev_knowledge_matrix_3: Knowledge matrix audit: Technical knowledge of data warehouse ETL lineage (kn_warehouse_lineage) is held solely by role_data_platform_lead and is about 20% documented in formal runbooks, representing a critical single point of failure.
ev_data_pipeline_runbook: Data Pipeline Runbook Section 4: If a scheduled ingestion batch in wf_data_refresh fails on sys_data_pipeline, the automated recovery mechanism replays the ingestion queue from the last verified checkpoint without data loss.
ev_architecture_core: Core Architecture Specification: The invoicing service (sys_invoicing) consumes the reconciled ledger produced by wf_billing_recon, while automated customer billing execution runs directly on sys_billing_platform.
ev_sop_financial_close_lineage: Monthly Financial Close SOP (wf_financial_close): If schema discrepancies or ETL reconciliation exceptions occur, accounting staff must defer all data warehouse lineage questions directly to role_data_platform_lead.
ev_kyc_screening_inputs: KYC Screening SOP (wf_kyc_screening): Mandatory customer verification under ctl_kyc_screening requires executing screening algorithms against both the Identity verification dataset (ds_identity_verification) and the Corporate linkage dataset (ds_corporate_linkage).
ev_apex_msa_renewal: ApexData Master Services Agreement Section 8.2: The annual subscription for vendor_apex shall auto-renew on day 60 for an additional term with an 8% price uplift unless written notice of non-renewal is delivered at least 30 days prior.
ev_beacon_msa_terms: BeaconIQ Master Services Agreement Section 12: Governing vendor_beacon service term end, requiring advance written notice prior to termination and specifying contractual one-time exit fees and transition assistance terms.
ev_cinder_msa_terms: CinderSignals Master Services Agreement Section 3.1: Provider grants Northstar Technologies an exclusive enterprise license for vendor_cinder intent signals (ds_intent_signals) for marketing campaign targeting.
ev_delta_msa_terms: DeltaVerify Master Services Agreement Section 11: Governs vendor_delta agreement term end, requiring formal written notice prior to termination and establishing contractual exit fees and data handover protocols.
ev_echo_msa_clause_9: EchoMarket Master Services Agreement Clause 9: Service agreement for vendor_echo renews automatically on day 120 with a 12% price uplift unless termination notice is submitted within the contractual window.
ev_flux_usage_pricing: FluxBehavior Master Services Agreement Schedule B: Invoicing for vendor_flux behavioural telemetry data (ds_usage) is calculated on a variable utility pricing schedule billed per record consumed each billing cycle.
ev_granite_msa_terms: GraniteGeo Master Services Agreement Section 10: Governs vendor_granite geographic data services term end, defining mandatory advance notice requirements and contractual exit fee obligations upon contract expiration.
ev_echo_history_retention: EchoMarket MSA Section 14 (Termination): Upon contract termination for vendor_echo, provider shall cease delivery of account intelligence; the agreement is silent on whether historical data is retained or purged.
ev_vendor_dataset_matrix: External Data Vendor Inventory: Master feed matrix mapping third-party data suppliers to discrete datasets, attribute groups, and consuming workflows across Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Compliance departments.
ev_vendor_recon_inputs: Vendor Reconciliation Workflow Map (wf_vendor_reconciliation): Scheduled reconciliation processes ingest external supplier billing statements matched against internal audit logs (ds_audit_log) to support ctl_sox_reconciliation.
ev_echo_account_intel_feed: Workflow specification note: In addition to standard ledger feeds, the Account intelligence dataset (ds_account_intel) also feeds the Vendor reconciliation workflow (wf_vendor_reconciliation) each month for partner volume audit.
